uniforms.name: DEEP_DebugView
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Chooses which deep-tone stage to inspect. Shaped Tone Field shows the signed local luminance shaping, Organic Support Luma shows the local support average, Tone Region Mask shows where the tone pivot and width permit shaping, Depth Stability Gate shows how depth continuity suppresses unstable shaping, Source Saturation shows the original chroma level, Computed Application Weight shows the final scalar shaping weight before color remap, the organic field views show the repeated support field geometry and real center footprint, Selected Mask and Fog Evidence show the Crystal-derived gates, and Final Application Gate shows the fully combined application gate.
uniforms.ui_items: Final Composite | Shaped Tone Field | Organic Support Luma | Tone Region Mask | Depth Stability Gate | Source Saturation | Computed Application Weight | Tiled Organic Support Field | Center Organic Support Footprint | Organic Support Strength | Selected Mask | Fog Evidence | Final Application Gate |

uniforms.name: DEEP_DebugExposure
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Brightens low-signal diagnostics so weak tone shaping, support, and gating fields are easier to inspect. Does not change the final image.

uniforms.name: DEEP_DebugGamma
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Display-only gamma for debug outputs. Lower values lift dim detail; higher values compress it. Does not change the final composite when the displayed output is Final.

uniforms.name: DEEP_DebugContrast
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Display-only contrast for masks, depth fields, detail fields, and other diagnostics. Does not alter the real effect path.

uniforms.name: DEEP_DebugBlackPoint
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Lower remap point for debug visualization. Raise it to clip low-level noise and isolate stronger diagnostic signal.

uniforms.name: DEEP_DebugWhitePoint
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Upper remap point for debug visualization. Lower it to expand faint masks, depth variation, and detail probes.

uniforms.name: DEEP_DebugInvert
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Inverts the shaped debug view only. Useful for inspecting dark depth, inverse masks, and negative-space coverage.
uniforms.ui_items: Off | On |

uniforms.name: DEEP_DebugPatternScale
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Scales only the repeated organic support debug field. This does not change the real support radius.

uniforms.name: DEEP_DebugPatternTiles
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Repeats the support field debug layout across the screen for easier spacing and rotation inspection.

uniforms.name: DEEP_DebugMarkerSize
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how large support taps appear in the debug field and center footprint views. This does not change real sampling.

uniforms.name: DEEP_DebugPatternSoftness
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Softens support tap markers and guide rings in debug only.

uniforms.name: DEEP_Enable
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Master enable for the deep-tone effect. Off returns the source image unchanged.
uniforms.ui_items: Off | On |

uniforms.name: DEEP_MasterIntensity
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Overall multiplier applied after local tone shaping, colorfulness shaping, and final gating are combined.

uniforms.name: DEEP_RichnessStrength
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Strength of the local luminance remap. Positive values deepen tone relationships; negative values invert the behavior toward lifting.

uniforms.name: DEEP_ColorfulnessStrength
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Optional chroma expansion applied after luminance remap. Higher values let strengthened tone structure carry more color separation.

uniforms.name: DEEP_LensMode
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Selects the Obsidian Mirror-derived lens family used to compute local organic tone support.
uniforms.ui_items: Off | Organic Lens55 | Golden Spiral Sweep | Staggered Lens55 | Ring9 | Spiral13 | Rect Horizontal15 | Rect Vertical15 | Diamond13 | Box25 |

uniforms.name: DEEP_QualityTier
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Caps the support tap budget before family-size clamping is applied.
uniforms.ui_items: Disciplined 9 | Broad 21 | High 34 | Ultra 55 |

uniforms.name: DEEP_TapBudget
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Requested tap count for the organic support field before quality-tier and family-size clamping are applied. This changes the real support field.

uniforms.name: DEEP_ReductionMode
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Sequential uses the earliest taps first. Staggered redistributes reduced support taps across the full canonical lens shape.
uniforms.ui_items: Sequential | Staggered |

uniforms.name: DEEP_FieldScale
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Scales the organic support lens constellation before it is converted into pixel-space support offsets.

uniforms.name: DEEP_FieldRotation
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Rotates the organic support field used to gather local tone context.

uniforms.name: DEEP_FibonacciAnchor
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Offsets the golden-angle phase used by Fibonacci-derived support lens families.

uniforms.name: DEEP_RadiusPixels
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Screen-space radius used to gather organic local tone support.

uniforms.name: DEEP_OrganicFlow
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Phase drift applied to the organic support direction generation.

uniforms.name: DEEP_TonePivot
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Luminance pivot where deep-tone shaping is strongest.

uniforms.name: DEEP_ToneWidth
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Width of the tonal region emphasized around the tone pivot.

uniforms.name: DEEP_LocalContrast
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Weight of immediate local tone contrast when shaping luminance.

uniforms.name: DEEP_ShadowLift
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Reduces excessive darkening in deep shadows by protecting the darkest tones.

uniforms.name: DEEP_HighlightCompression
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Restrains over-expansion in highlights so deep tone does not become highlight lift.

uniforms.name: DEEP_DepthGate
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Suppresses deep-tone shaping when local depth is unstable.

uniforms.name: DEEP_MaskMode
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Selects the Crystal-derived field used to gate deep-tone application.
uniforms.ui_items: Off | Fog Evidence | Light Shield | Depth Window | Far Detail Stack | Contrast | Composite Guard |

uniforms.name: DEEP_MaskInfluence
uniforms.ui_tooltip: How strongly the selected mask field influences the final deep-tone application gate.

uniforms.name: DEEP_FogInfluence
uniforms.ui_tooltip: How strongly fog-like regions reduce deep-tone application.

uniforms.name: DEEP_DepthMode
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how the depth buffer is interpreted by the Crystal-derived gating logic.
uniforms.ui_items: ReShade Linearized | Raw Depth | Raw Inverted |

uniforms.name: DEEP_DepthInvert
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Inverts depth interpretation for reversed depth buffers.
uniforms.ui_items: No | Yes |

uniforms.name: DEEP_DepthTraceScale
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Amplifies small depth differences before depth-driven masks are evaluated.

uniforms.name: DEEP_DepthAvailabilityThreshold
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Minimum local depth activity needed before depth-driven masks trust the buffer.

uniforms.name: DEEP_DepthStart
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Near boundary of the depth window mask.

uniforms.name: DEEP_DepthEnd
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Far boundary of the depth window mask.

uniforms.name: DEEP_DepthEdgeThreshold
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Depth discontinuity threshold used by depth-derived gating logic.

uniforms.name: DEEP_FarDetailStart
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Near boundary where the far-detail mask begins to activate.

uniforms.name: DEEP_FarDetailEnd
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Boundary where the far-detail mask reaches full strength.

uniforms.name: DEEP_DetailLow
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Low threshold of the detail detector used by the far-detail mask.

uniforms.name: DEEP_DetailHigh
uniforms.ui_tooltip: High threshold of the detail detector used by the far-detail mask.

uniforms.name: DEEP_DetailScale
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Scales the detail detector used by the far-detail mask.

uniforms.name: DEEP_ContrastThreshold
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Threshold used by the contrast-derived mask field.

uniforms.name: DEEP_ContrastGain
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Gain applied to the local-contrast detector before the contrast mask is formed.

uniforms.name: DEEP_FogBrightnessFloor
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Minimum scene brightness before fog evidence begins to register.

uniforms.name: DEEP_FogDesaturation
uniforms.ui_tooltip: How colorless a region must be before fog evidence rises.

uniforms.name: DEEP_FogLowContrast
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Upper contrast ceiling used by the fog evidence detector.

uniforms.name: DEEP_LightThreshold
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Brightness threshold where the light-shield detector starts treating pixels as emissive or highlight-critical.

uniforms.name: DEEP_LightSoftness
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Soft transition width for the light-shield detector.

uniforms.name: DEEP_LineThreshold
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Edge threshold used by line-like structure suppression inside the fog-evidence logic.

uniforms.ui_tooltip: Selects the active mined hatch family. Stability Hatch is a non-temporal branch mined from organic hatch TAA ideas, using depth, luma, and edge rejection to stabilize where hatch is allowed to survive. Cross Hatch adds a disciplined two-angle ink weave that thickens naturally in darker regions.
uniforms.ui_items: Off | Procedural Bio Hatch | Five-Stage Hatch | Log Spiral Branch Hatch | Adaptive Hatch Clarity | Stability Hatch | Cross Hatch |

uniforms.name: CROOKED_HatchStrength
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how strongly the active hatch effect influences the source image. For shading modes it darkens and textures the scene; for Adaptive Hatch Clarity it scales hatch-placed clarity emphasis.

uniforms.name: CROOKED_TapBudget
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how many Lens55 taps contribute to the real hatch field, not just debug preview. Higher values increase pattern richness and directional continuity.

uniforms.name: CROOKED_PatternScale
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls the UV scale of the real hatch field. Larger values tighten stroke frequency; smaller values broaden it.

uniforms.name: CROOKED_Density
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls the frequency of the mined procedural hatch lines in the actual image output. Higher values produce denser and more tightly packed stroke structure.

uniforms.name: CROOKED_Flow
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Offsets the directional phase used by the procedural hatch families in the live hatch field. Changing it alters drift and branch motion within the static pattern field.

uniforms.name: CROOKED_TapSpread
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how far Lens55 taps are spread through UV space when synthesizing the real procedural hatch field. Larger values increase spatial reach and loosen local repetition.

uniforms.name: CROOKED_FibonacciAnchor
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Offsets the Fibonacci phase used by the procedural hatch families in the live hatch field. This changes directional sequencing and branch phasing without changing tap count.

uniforms.name: CROOKED_SpiralGrowth
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how quickly the log-spiral branch hatch expands as it moves away from the center. Larger values make the branch family flare outward faster.

uniforms.name: CROOKED_SpiralTightness
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how tightly the log-spiral branch field winds. Higher values produce more turns and denser spiral wrapping.

uniforms.name: CROOKED_BranchCount
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how many primary arms the log-spiral branch hatch distributes around the center. More branches create denser radial subdivision.

uniforms.name: CROOKED_BranchBlend
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Blends between local Lens55 direction and recursive spiral branch direction in the log-spiral hatch family.

uniforms.name: CROOKED_ClarityRadius
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Pixel radius for the compact clarity kernel used by Adaptive Hatch Clarity. Larger values broaden the local clarity neighborhood and make the effect read less like sharpening and more like structure lift.

uniforms.name: CROOKED_KernelAngle
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Orientation in degrees for the compact clarity kernel. Rotating it changes the dominant direction of the local clarity probe without rotating the hatch field itself.

uniforms.name: CROOKED_HighlightProtect
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Reduces clarity lift in bright highlights for Adaptive Hatch Clarity. Higher values protect hot pixels and reflective accents from sparkle and halos.

uniforms.name: CROOKED_MidtoneBias
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Biases Adaptive Hatch Clarity toward midtones instead of deep shadows or bright highlights. Higher values concentrate the effect on the body of the image.

uniforms.name: CROOKED_StabilityDepthRejectStart
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Smallest depth mismatch that begins suppressing Stability Hatch. Lower values make the hatch more cautious around depth breaks.

uniforms.name: CROOKED_StabilityDepthRejectEnd
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Depth mismatch where Stability Hatch is fully suppressed. Raise it to tolerate broader local depth variation before the hatch is rejected.

uniforms.name: CROOKED_StabilityLumaResponse
uniforms.ui_tooltip: How strongly local luma disagreement suppresses Stability Hatch. Higher values favor cleaner, more selective hatch persistence.

uniforms.name: CROOKED_StabilityEdgeInfluence
uniforms.ui_tooltip: How strongly edge activity suppresses Stability Hatch. Raise it to keep hatching off unstable or rapidly changing contours.

techniques.name: CrookedTongue
techniques.ui_label: Crooked Tongue :: Hatch Pattern And Shading Server
techniques.ui_tooltip: Displays and applies hatch pattern fields, shading masks, and clarity or stability modifiers using procedural bio, multistage, spiral, and cross-hatch structures.

uniforms.name: CRYSTAL_DebugView
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Chooses which mask stage to inspect. Selected Mask shows the final result of the current Selected Mask Field, Branch Direct Field shows the raw branch signal behind the current selection, Composite Guard shows the broader combined protection field, the three depth diagnostics validate the depth feed, and Masked Preview shows the selected mask applied over the image.
uniforms.ui_items: Final (Passthrough) | Selected Mask | Branch Direct Field | Composite Guard | Shaped Linear Depth | Depth Confidence | Depth Discontinuity | Masked Preview |

uniforms.name: CRYSTAL_DebugExposure
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Brightens low-signal mask diagnostics so weak protection fields are easier to inspect. Does not affect passthrough output.

uniforms.name: CRYSTAL_DebugGamma
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Display-only gamma for debug outputs. Lower values lift dim detail; higher values compress it. Does not change the final composite when the displayed output is Final.

uniforms.name: CRYSTAL_DebugContrast
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Display-only contrast for masks, depth fields, detail fields, and other diagnostics. Does not alter the real effect path.

uniforms.name: CRYSTAL_DebugBlackPoint
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Lower remap point for debug visualization. Raise it to clip low-level noise and isolate stronger diagnostic signal.

uniforms.name: CRYSTAL_DebugWhitePoint
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Upper remap point for debug visualization. Lower it to expand faint masks, depth variation, and detail probes.

uniforms.name: CRYSTAL_DebugInvert
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Inverts the shaped debug view only. Useful for inspecting dark depth, inverse masks, and negative-space coverage.
uniforms.ui_items: Off | On |

uniforms.name: CRYSTAL_CompositeDebugBranch
uniforms.ui_tooltip: When Selected Mask Field is Composite Guard, Branch Direct Field uses this control to choose which underlying component branch to show directly.
uniforms.ui_items: Fog Evidence | Light Shield | Line Guard | Pixel Guard | Depth Window | Far Detail Stack | Contrast | Hue Warm | Directional | Silhouette Guard |

uniforms.name: CRYSTAL_Enable
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Master enable for the mined image-mask modes. Off keeps the module in passthrough-only mode.
uniforms.ui_items: Off | On |

uniforms.name: CRYSTAL_MaskMode
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Selects the active mined mask family. The compact gates cover contrast selection, warm-hue selection, directional support, and silhouette protection, while Composite Guard folds them into the broader protection field.
uniforms.ui_items: Off | Fog Evidence | Light Shield | Line Guard | Pixel Guard | Depth Window | Far Detail Stack | Foreground Guard | Contrast | Hue Warm | Directional | Silhouette Guard | Composite Guard |

uniforms.name: CRYSTAL_MaskStrength
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Scales the intensity of the active mined mask in the real image, not just the debug views. Higher values make weak fields apply more strongly and also easier to inspect.

uniforms.name: CRYSTAL_FogBrightnessFloor
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Minimum scene brightness before fog evidence begins to register. Raising it restricts fog detection to brighter haze and mist.

uniforms.name: CRYSTAL_FogDesaturation
uniforms.ui_tooltip: How colorless a region must be before fog evidence increases. Higher values focus the mask on neutral fog rather than tinted atmosphere.

uniforms.name: CRYSTAL_FogLowContrast
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Local contrast threshold used by the fog evidence mask. Lower values make the fog gate more selective; higher values let flatter regions qualify more easily.

uniforms.name: CRYSTAL_LightThreshold
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Brightness threshold where the light shield starts to treat pixels as emissive or highlight-critical.

uniforms.name: CRYSTAL_LightSoftness
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Soft transition width for the light shield. Larger values broaden the highlight protection ramp instead of clipping abruptly.

uniforms.name: CRYSTAL_LineThreshold
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Gradient threshold where the line guard begins to register. Lower values catch more fine structure; higher values focus on stronger edges.

uniforms.name: CRYSTAL_PixelThreshold
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Brightness threshold used by the pixel guard. Lower values catch more bright micro-pixels; higher values isolate only the hottest points.

uniforms.name: CRYSTAL_PixelSaturation
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Saturation threshold used by the pixel guard. This helps protect very colorful hot pixels and emissive accents.

uniforms.name: CRYSTAL_DepthStart
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Near boundary of the generic depth window. This also helps define the near-side region protected by Foreground Guard and Far Detail Stack.

uniforms.name: CRYSTAL_DepthEnd
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Far boundary of the generic depth window. Together with Depth Start, this also defines how far the near-side foreground protection extends.

uniforms.name: CRYSTAL_ForegroundNearStart
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Near boundary used specifically by Foreground Guard. Lower values reserve protection for the closest geometry only; higher values let more mid-depth objects count as foreground.

uniforms.name: CRYSTAL_ForegroundNearEnd
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Far boundary used specifically by Foreground Guard. This decouples foreground protection from the generic Depth Window so both can be tuned independently.

uniforms.name: CRYSTAL_DepthInvert
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Inverts near and far interpretation for reversed depth buffers or alternative depth conventions.
uniforms.ui_items: No | Yes |

uniforms.name: CRYSTAL_DepthMode
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Chooses how depth is interpreted before the mined depth-aware masks are evaluated. Switch this when the depth views look flat or reversed.
uniforms.ui_items: Linearized | Raw Depth | Raw Inverted |

uniforms.name: CRYSTAL_DepthTraceScale
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Amplifies small depth differences before depth availability, depth edge, and far-detail gating are evaluated. Raise it when the scene has valid depth but the detail and guard masks are too faint.

uniforms.name: CRYSTAL_DepthAvailabilityThreshold
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Minimum local depth activity needed before the depth-aware masks trust the buffer. Lower values accept weaker depth; higher values demand a clearer signal.

uniforms.name: CRYSTAL_DepthEdgeThreshold
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Depth discontinuity threshold for the foreground guard and far-detail stack. Lower values catch more silhouette edges; higher values reserve the guard for stronger breaks.

uniforms.name: CRYSTAL_FarDetailStart
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Near boundary of the far-detail region. Pixels beyond this point begin to qualify for the far-detail stack.

uniforms.name: CRYSTAL_FarDetailEnd
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Full-strength boundary of the far-detail region. Raising it pushes the stack deeper into the scene; lowering it brings detail gating closer.

uniforms.name: CRYSTAL_DetailLow
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Lower threshold for the lens-contrast detail test used by the far-detail stack. Lower values allow weaker texture variation to qualify.

uniforms.name: CRYSTAL_DetailHigh
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Upper threshold for the lens-contrast detail test. Higher values make the far-detail stack more selective about what counts as preserved structure.

uniforms.name: CRYSTAL_DetailScale
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Gain applied to the ring and spiral contrast probes before thresholding. Raise it when detail masks are structurally correct but too weak.

uniforms.name: CRYSTAL_ForegroundNearStrength
uniforms.ui_tooltip: How strongly near-depth pixels block the far-detail stack. Higher values more aggressively preserve foreground subjects.

uniforms.name: CRYSTAL_ForegroundEdgeStrength
uniforms.ui_tooltip: How strongly depth silhouettes block the far-detail stack. Higher values carve out more of the foreground outline from distant detail gating.

uniforms.name: CRYSTAL_ContrastThreshold
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Minimum local luminance variation required before the Contrast mask turns on. Lower values catch more texture and edges; higher values reserve the mask for stronger structural change.

uniforms.name: CRYSTAL_ContrastGain
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Amplifies local contrast before thresholding. Raise it when the mask is conceptually correct but too faint to separate useful structure from the surrounding image.

uniforms.name: CRYSTAL_HueWarmWidth
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Hue-wheel width of the warm gate. Lower values isolate a tighter warm band; higher values include more orange, red, and gold-adjacent hues.

uniforms.name: CRYSTAL_DirectionalAngle
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Primary angle used by the directional gate. Rotate it to align the mask with the dominant scene direction you want to favor.

uniforms.name: CRYSTAL_DirectionalSoftness
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Softness of the directional gate. Lower values make the selected direction narrow and strict; higher values broaden acceptance around the chosen angle.

uniforms.name: CRYSTAL_SilhouetteStrength
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Scales how strongly depth-edge silhouettes register in the silhouette guard. Raise it to favor stronger cutout protection around subject outlines.

techniques.name: CrystalMass
techniques.ui_label: Crystal Mass :: Image Mask And Protection Server
techniques.ui_tooltip: Displays and applies image masks for fog-like regions, highlights, depth ranges, contrast, hue, direction, silhouettes, and combined protection behavior.

uniforms.name: AO_DebugView
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Chooses which ambient-occlusion stage to inspect. The first three views show isolated pass outputs, Combined Occlusion shows the merged raw occlusion before darkening, the representative sampling field views show the repeated local lens structure and center-anchored footprint using the strongest active AO sampling pass, Representative Sampling Field Strength shows scalar sampling-field intensity at the current pixel, the application field views show the repeated local placement structure and center-anchored placement footprint, Application Field Strength shows scalar placement-field intensity at the current pixel, Selected Mask shows the raw selected mask result, Fog Evidence shows the atmosphere detector directly, and Final AO Gate shows the fully combined occlusion gate.
uniforms.ui_items: Final Composite | Base Occlusion | Broad Occlusion | Superfine Occlusion | Combined Occlusion | Tiled Representative Sampling Field | Center Representative Sampling Footprint | Representative Sampling Field Strength | Tiled Application Field | Center Application Footprint | Application Field Strength | Selected Mask | Fog Evidence | Final AO Gate |

uniforms.name: AO_DebugExposure
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Brightens low-signal diagnostics so weak occlusion, lens, and gate fields are easier to inspect. Does not change Final Composite.

uniforms.name: AO_DebugGamma
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Display-only gamma for debug outputs. Lower values lift dim detail; higher values compress it. Does not change the final composite when the displayed output is Final.

uniforms.name: AO_DebugContrast
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Display-only contrast for masks, depth fields, detail fields, and other diagnostics. Does not alter the real effect path.

uniforms.name: AO_DebugBlackPoint
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Lower remap point for debug visualization. Raise it to clip low-level noise and isolate stronger diagnostic signal.

uniforms.name: AO_DebugWhitePoint
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Upper remap point for debug visualization. Lower it to expand faint masks, depth variation, and detail probes.

uniforms.name: AO_DebugInvert
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Inverts the shaped debug view only. Useful for inspecting dark depth, inverse masks, and negative-space coverage.
uniforms.ui_items: Off | On |

uniforms.name: AO_DebugPatternScale
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Scales the tiled debug field views only. This does not change the real ambient occlusion radius.

uniforms.name: AO_DebugPatternTiles
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Repeats the debug field layout across the screen. This is only for reading spacing and rotation.

uniforms.name: AO_DebugMarkerSize
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how large each tap marker appears in the debug field and footprint views. This does not change the real sample size.

uniforms.name: AO_DebugPatternSoftness
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Softens debug marker edges and guide rings. This is a readability control for debug only.

uniforms.name: AO_Enable
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Master enable for the three-pass ambient-occlusion stack. Off returns the source image unchanged.
uniforms.ui_items: Off | On |

uniforms.name: AO_EnableBase
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Enables the small-radius base occlusion pass. This is the primary contact and cavity layer.
uniforms.ui_items: Off | On |

uniforms.name: AO_EnableBroad
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Enables the broad-radius occlusion pass. This adds larger-form grounding and distance-weighted structure.
uniforms.ui_items: Off | On |

uniforms.name: AO_EnableSuperfine
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Enables the superfine micro-occlusion pass. This concentrates on tiny creases and local structure without carrying the whole shadow load.
uniforms.ui_items: Off | On |

uniforms.name: AO_MasterIntensity
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Overall strength multiplier for the final AO darkening after all three passes and placement gating are combined.

uniforms.name: AO_SamplingLensMode
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Selects the Obsidian Mirror-derived lens family used to gather occlusion samples for all three passes.
uniforms.ui_items: Off | Organic Lens55 | Golden Spiral Sweep | Staggered Lens55 | Ring9 | Spiral13 | Rect Horizontal15 | Rect Vertical15 | Diamond13 | Box25 |

uniforms.name: AO_ApplicationLensMode
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Selects the Obsidian Mirror-derived lens field used to shape where the final AO is allowed to land.
uniforms.ui_items: Off | Organic Lens55 | Golden Spiral Sweep | Staggered Lens55 | Ring9 | Spiral13 | Rect Horizontal15 | Rect Vertical15 | Diamond13 | Box25 |

uniforms.name: AO_QualityTier
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Caps pass tap budgets before each pass resolves its own active count. Higher tiers keep more of the high-quality tap field alive.
uniforms.ui_items: Disciplined 9 | Broad 21 | High 34 | Ultra 55 |

uniforms.name: AO_ReductionMode
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Sequential consumes the earliest taps first. Staggered redistributes reduced tap counts across the full canonical shape of the active lens so lower budgets stay spatially balanced.
uniforms.ui_items: Sequential | Staggered |

uniforms.name: AO_FieldScale
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Scales the underlying Obsidian Mirror lens constellation before it is converted into pixel-space sampling offsets for the real AO field.

uniforms.name: AO_FieldRotation
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Rotates the active lens field in the real AO sampling and application paths. This mostly affects directional or anisotropic families like the rectangular and diamond shapes.

uniforms.name: AO_FibonacciAnchor
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Offsets the golden-angle phase used by the Fibonacci-derived tap families. Changing it re-phases the sample ordering without changing tap count.

uniforms.name: AO_ApplicationTapBudget
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Requested tap count for the application lens field before quality-tier and family-size clamping are applied. This changes the real placement field, not just debug, and does not affect sampling.

uniforms.name: AO_ApplicationRadiusPixels
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Pixel radius used to evaluate the application lens field in the real AO output. Larger values make the placement field respond to broader neighborhood structure.

uniforms.name: AO_ApplicationLensStrength
uniforms.ui_tooltip: How strongly the application lens field modulates where the final ambient occlusion is allowed to land.

uniforms.name: AO_BaseTapBudget
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Requested tap count for the base pass before quality-tier and family-size clamping are applied.

uniforms.name: AO_BaseRadiusPixels
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Pixel radius of the base pass. Smaller values stay close to contact edges and creases.

uniforms.name: AO_BaseStrength
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Strength of the base occlusion pass. Higher values deepen contact shadows and small cavities.

uniforms.name: AO_BaseRejectStart
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Beginning of the depth delta ramp that starts counting neighboring geometry as occluding for the base pass.

uniforms.name: AO_BaseRejectEnd
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Depth delta where the base pass reaches full occlusion response. Lower values make the pass tighter and more crease-focused.

uniforms.name: AO_BroadTapBudget
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Requested tap count for the broad pass before quality-tier and family-size clamping are applied.

uniforms.name: AO_BroadRadiusPixels
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Pixel radius of the broad pass. Larger values push the effect into larger-form grounding and wider ambient shaping.

uniforms.name: AO_BroadStrength
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Strength of the broad occlusion pass. Higher values add more large-scale grounding and scene mass.

uniforms.name: AO_BroadRejectStart
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Beginning of the broad-pass depth delta ramp. Lower values make the pass respond to subtler depth enclosure.

uniforms.name: AO_BroadRejectEnd
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Depth delta where the broad pass reaches full occlusion response. Higher values tolerate more variation before the pass saturates.

uniforms.name: AO_BroadDistanceFalloff
uniforms.ui_tooltip: How quickly far taps lose influence in the broad pass. Lower values keep the pass more evenly distributed across the radius.

uniforms.name: AO_SuperfineTapBudget
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Requested tap count for the superfine pass before quality-tier and family-size clamping are applied.

uniforms.name: AO_SuperfineRadiusPixels
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Pixel radius of the superfine pass. Smaller values concentrate on tiny creases and local micro-structure.

uniforms.name: AO_SuperfineStrength
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Strength of the superfine pass. Higher values deepen micro-cavities and fine structure without changing the broader shape.

uniforms.name: AO_SuperfineRejectStart
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Beginning of the superfine depth delta ramp. Lower values make tiny depth changes register earlier.

uniforms.name: AO_SuperfineRejectEnd
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Depth delta where the superfine pass reaches full occlusion response. Lower values keep it tighter and more surgical.

uniforms.name: AO_SuperfineContrastThreshold
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Minimum local contrast needed before the superfine pass fully trusts a tiny occlusion signal. Raise it to avoid broad low-detail darkening.

uniforms.name: AO_SuperfineContrastGain
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Amplifies local contrast before it modulates the superfine pass. Higher values make the pass cling more strongly to sharp local detail.

uniforms.name: AO_MaskMode
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Selects the Crystal Mass-derived field used to shape where ambient occlusion is allowed to land. Composite Guard combines depth, contrast, distance, and protection behavior into a broader placement guide.
uniforms.ui_items: Off | Fog Evidence | Light Shield | Depth Window | Far Detail Stack | Contrast | Composite Guard |

uniforms.name: AO_MaskInfluence
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Blends between ungated occlusion and the selected mask field. Lower values expose the raw pass structure; higher values enforce the mask more strongly.

uniforms.name: AO_MaskStrength
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Scales the selected mask field before it is blended into the final AO gate.

uniforms.name: AO_DepthMode
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Chooses how depth is interpreted before the three AO passes and the Crystal Mass-derived guards evaluate the scene.
uniforms.ui_items: Linearized | Raw Depth | Raw Inverted |

uniforms.name: AO_DepthInvert
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Inverts near and far interpretation for reversed depth buffers or alternative depth conventions.
uniforms.ui_items: No | Yes |

uniforms.name: AO_DepthTraceScale
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Amplifies small depth differences before availability, edge, and reject logic are evaluated. Raise it when valid depth exists but the occlusion passes are too faint.

uniforms.name: AO_DepthAvailabilityThreshold
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Minimum local depth activity required before depth-aware filters fully trust the buffer. Lower values accept weaker depth; higher values demand a clearer signal.

uniforms.name: AO_DepthEdgeThreshold
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Threshold used by the depth-discontinuity logic. Lower values catch more silhouette changes; higher values reserve the signal for stronger breaks.

uniforms.name: AO_DepthStart
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Near boundary of the generic depth window used by the depth and composite masks.

uniforms.name: AO_DepthEnd
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Far boundary of the generic depth window used by the depth and composite masks.

uniforms.name: AO_FarDetailStart
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Beginning of the far-distance range used by the far-detail and composite masks.

uniforms.name: AO_FarDetailEnd
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Point where far-distance qualification reaches full strength for the far-detail and composite masks.

uniforms.name: AO_FogBrightnessFloor
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Minimum brightness before the fog evidence branch begins to react. Raise it to ignore dim haze and focus on brighter atmosphere.

uniforms.name: AO_FogDesaturation
uniforms.ui_tooltip: How colorless a region should be before fog evidence strengthens. Higher values focus more tightly on neutral mist and haze.

uniforms.name: AO_FogLowContrast
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Local-contrast threshold used by the fog evidence branch. Lower values make fog detection more selective; higher values allow flatter structure to qualify more easily.

uniforms.name: AO_LightThreshold
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Brightness threshold used by the light-protection branch. Lower values protect more highlights and emissive accents.

uniforms.name: AO_LightSoftness
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Transition width of the light-protection branch. Higher values broaden highlight protection instead of clipping it abruptly.

uniforms.name: AO_ContrastThreshold
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Minimum local contrast required before the contrast branch qualifies. Lower values catch more texture; higher values reserve the field for clearer structure.

uniforms.name: AO_ContrastGain
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Gain applied to the local contrast probe before thresholding. Raise it when structurally correct contrast fields are too faint to be useful.

techniques.name: DeathGaze
techniques.ui_label: Death Gaze :: Three Pass Ambient Occlusion
techniques.ui_tooltip: Darkens the image with three occlusion layers: contact shadows, broad grounding shadows, and superfine crevice shadows.

uniforms.ui_items: Off | Organic Lens55 | Golden Spiral Sweep | Staggered Lens55 | Ring9 | Spiral13 | Rect Horizontal15 | Rect Vertical15 | Diamond13 | Box25 |

uniforms.name: SSR_ApplicationLensMode
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Selects the Obsidian Mirror-derived field used to shape where the final reflection is allowed to land.
uniforms.ui_items: Off | Organic Lens55 | Golden Spiral Sweep | Staggered Lens55 | Ring9 | Spiral13 | Rect Horizontal15 | Rect Vertical15 | Diamond13 | Box25 |

uniforms.name: SSR_QualityTier
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Caps pass tap budgets before each pass resolves its own active count. Higher tiers keep more of the high-quality tap field alive.
uniforms.ui_items: Disciplined 9 | Broad 21 | High 34 | Ultra 55 |

uniforms.name: SSR_ReductionMode
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Sequential consumes the earliest taps first. Staggered redistributes reduced tap counts across the full canonical shape of the active lens so lower budgets stay spatially balanced.
uniforms.ui_items: Sequential | Staggered |

uniforms.name: SSR_FieldScale
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Scales the underlying Obsidian Mirror lens constellation before it is converted into pixel-space reflection offsets for the real SSR image.

uniforms.name: SSR_FieldRotation
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Rotates the active lens field in the real SSR sampling and placement paths. This mainly affects directional and anisotropic lens families such as the rectangular and diamond variants.

uniforms.name: SSR_FibonacciAnchor
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Offsets the golden-angle phase used by the Fibonacci-derived tap families. Changing it re-phases sample ordering without changing tap count.

uniforms.name: SSR_ApplicationTapBudget
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Requested tap count for the application lens field before quality-tier and family-size clamping are applied. This changes the real placement field, not just debug, and does not affect reflection sampling.

uniforms.name: SSR_ApplicationRadiusPixels
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Pixel radius used to evaluate the application lens field in the real SSR output. Larger values make the placement field respond to broader neighborhood structure.

uniforms.name: SSR_ApplicationLensStrength
uniforms.ui_tooltip: How strongly the application lens field modulates where the final reflection is allowed to land.

uniforms.name: SSR_HighlightTapBudget
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Requested tap count for the highlight pass before quality-tier and family-size clamping are applied.

uniforms.name: SSR_HighlightRadiusPixels
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Pixel radius of the highlight reflection pass. Smaller values keep highlights tight and sharp.

uniforms.name: SSR_HighlightStrength
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Strength of the highlight reflection pass. Higher values emphasize bright reflected peaks and specular accents.

uniforms.name: SSR_HighlightBrightStart
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Brightness where samples begin to qualify strongly for the highlight pass.

uniforms.name: SSR_HighlightBrightEnd
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Brightness where the highlight pass reaches full reflective emphasis.

uniforms.name: SSR_BaseTapBudget
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Requested tap count for the base reflection pass before quality-tier and family-size clamping are applied.

uniforms.name: SSR_BaseRadiusPixels
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Pixel radius of the base reflection pass. Larger values reach farther along the reflection direction.

uniforms.name: SSR_BaseStrength
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Strength of the base reflection pass. This is the main body reflection layer.

uniforms.name: SSR_BaseDepthRejectStart
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Beginning of the depth mismatch ramp that starts rejecting off-surface reflected samples for the base pass.

uniforms.name: SSR_BaseDepthRejectEnd
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Depth mismatch where the base pass fully rejects reflected samples. Lower values keep it more surface-tight.

uniforms.name: SSR_BaseDistanceFalloff
uniforms.ui_tooltip: How quickly far reflected taps lose influence in the base pass. Lower values keep the pass more evenly distributed along the reflection direction.

uniforms.name: SSR_GlossTapBudget
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Requested tap count for the gloss pass before quality-tier and family-size clamping are applied.

uniforms.name: SSR_GlossRadiusPixels
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Pixel radius of the gloss reflection pass. Larger values broaden the reflected field into a smoother glossy response.

uniforms.name: SSR_GlossStrength
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Strength of the gloss reflection pass. Higher values make the broader reflective sheen more visible.

uniforms.name: SSR_GlossDepthRejectStart
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Beginning of the depth mismatch ramp for the gloss pass. Lower values make the pass adhere more tightly to the current surface.

uniforms.name: SSR_GlossDepthRejectEnd
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Depth mismatch where the gloss pass fully rejects reflected samples. Higher values let the pass stay broader and smoother.

uniforms.name: SSR_GlossDistanceFalloff
uniforms.ui_tooltip: How quickly far reflected taps lose influence in the gloss pass. Lower values keep the glossy sheen broad and even.

uniforms.name: SSR_GlossBlend
uniforms.ui_tooltip: How strongly the gloss pass blends toward a smoother average reflection instead of preserving sharper reflected detail.

uniforms.name: SSR_MaskMode
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Selects the Crystal Mass-derived field used to shape where reflections are allowed to land. Composite Guard combines depth, contrast, distance, and protection behavior into a broader placement guide.
uniforms.ui_items: Off | Fog Evidence | Light Shield | Depth Window | Far Detail Stack | Contrast | Composite Guard |

uniforms.name: SSR_MaskInfluence
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Blends between ungated reflections and the selected mask field. Lower values expose the raw pass structure; higher values enforce the placement mask more strongly.

uniforms.name: SSR_MaskStrength
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Scales the selected mask field before it is blended into the final reflection gate.

uniforms.name: SSR_DepthMode
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Chooses how depth is interpreted before the three reflection passes and the Crystal Mass-derived guards evaluate the scene.
uniforms.ui_items: Linearized | Raw Depth | Raw Inverted |

uniforms.name: SSR_DepthInvert
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Inverts near and far interpretation for reversed depth buffers or alternative depth conventions.
uniforms.ui_items: No | Yes |

uniforms.name: SSR_DepthTraceScale
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Amplifies small depth differences before availability, edge, and reject logic are evaluated. Raise it when valid depth exists but reflection acceptance is too weak.

uniforms.name: SSR_DepthAvailabilityThreshold
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Minimum local depth activity required before depth-aware filters fully trust the buffer. Lower values accept weaker depth; higher values demand a clearer signal.

uniforms.name: SSR_DepthEdgeThreshold
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Threshold used by the depth-discontinuity logic. Lower values catch more silhouette changes; higher values reserve the signal for stronger breaks.

uniforms.name: SSR_DepthStart
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Near boundary of the generic depth window used by the depth and composite masks.

uniforms.name: SSR_DepthEnd
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Far boundary of the generic depth window used by the depth and composite masks.

uniforms.name: SSR_FarDetailStart
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Beginning of the far-distance range used by the far-detail and composite masks.

uniforms.name: SSR_FarDetailEnd
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Point where far-distance qualification reaches full strength for the far-detail and composite masks.

uniforms.name: SSR_FogBrightnessFloor
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Minimum brightness before the fog evidence branch begins to react. Raise it to ignore dim haze and focus on brighter atmosphere.

uniforms.name: SSR_FogDesaturation
uniforms.ui_tooltip: How colorless a region should be before fog evidence strengthens. Higher values focus more tightly on neutral mist and haze.

uniforms.name: SSR_FogLowContrast
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Local-contrast threshold used by the fog evidence branch. Lower values make fog detection more selective; higher values allow flatter structure to qualify more easily.

uniforms.name: SSR_LightThreshold
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Brightness threshold used by the light-protection branch. Lower values protect more highlights and emissive accents.

uniforms.name: SSR_LightSoftness
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Transition width of the light-protection branch. Higher values broaden highlight protection instead of clipping it abruptly.

uniforms.name: SSR_ContrastThreshold
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Minimum local contrast required before the contrast branch qualifies. Lower values catch more texture; higher values reserve the field for clearer structure.

uniforms.name: SSR_ContrastGain
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Gain applied to the local contrast probe before thresholding. Raise it when structurally correct contrast fields are too faint to be useful.

techniques.name: FoolsGold
techniques.ui_label: Fools Gold :: Three Pass Screen Space Reflection
techniques.ui_tooltip: Builds reflections in three layers: bright highlight reflections, general base reflections, and broad gloss reflections.

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_DebugView
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Chooses which Golden Hour stage to inspect. Local Indirect shows the filtered gathered light, Bounce Contribution shows the brightened difference from the source, the tiled field views show repeated local field structure, the center footprint views show the real center-anchored tap footprint, Sampling Field Strength and Application Field Strength show scalar field intensity at the current pixel, Depth Accept Field shows how well the gather survives depth rejection, Selected Mask shows the raw selected mask result, Fog Evidence shows the atmosphere detector directly, Final Application Gate shows the fully combined indirect-light gate, and Breakup Field shows the optional structural modulation field.
uniforms.ui_items: Final Composite | Local Indirect | Bounce Contribution | Tiled Sampling Field | Center Sampling Footprint | Sampling Field Strength | Tiled Application Field | Center Application Footprint | Application Field Strength | Depth Accept Field | Selected Mask | Fog Evidence | Final Application Gate | Breakup Field |

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_DebugExposure
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Brightens low-signal diagnostics so weak gather, mask, and tap fields are easier to inspect. Does not change Final Composite.

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_DebugGamma
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Display-only gamma for debug outputs. Lower values lift dim detail; higher values compress it. Does not change the final composite when the displayed output is Final.

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_DebugContrast
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Display-only contrast for masks, depth fields, detail fields, and other diagnostics. Does not alter the real effect path.

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_DebugBlackPoint
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Lower remap point for debug visualization. Raise it to clip low-level noise and isolate stronger diagnostic signal.

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_DebugWhitePoint
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Upper remap point for debug visualization. Lower it to expand faint masks, depth variation, and detail probes.

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_DebugInvert
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Inverts the shaped debug view only. Useful for inspecting dark depth, inverse masks, and negative-space coverage.
uniforms.ui_items: Off | On |

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_DebugPatternScale
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Scales the tiled debug field views only. This changes how large the repeated debug field appears on screen and does not change the real sampling or application radius.

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_DebugPatternTiles
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Repeats the debug field layout across the screen. This is only for reading spacing and rotation and does not affect the real indirect-light image.

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_DebugMarkerSize
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how large each tap marker appears in the tiled field views and center footprint views. This does not change the real sample size.

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_DebugPatternSoftness
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Softens debug marker edges and guide rings. This is a readability control for debug only.

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_Enable
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Master enable for the Golden Hour gather GI. Off returns the source image unchanged.
uniforms.ui_items: Off | On |

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_MasterIntensity
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Overall strength multiplier for the final indirect-light contribution after all gather, mask, and breakup shaping.

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_GIStrength
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Scales the recovered bounce contribution before it is composited over the source. Raise it when the indirect field is structurally right but too faint.

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_MaxContribution
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Upper cap on how much gathered light may brighten the source. Lower values keep the effect conservative; higher values let bright bounce accumulate more strongly.

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_SamplingLensMode
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Selects the Obsidian Mirror-derived tap geometry used to gather indirect light. Lens55 families favor broad quality gathers, while the smaller structured lenses favor more disciplined local support.
uniforms.ui_items: Off | Organic Lens55 | Golden Spiral Sweep | Staggered Lens55 | Ring9 | Spiral13 | Rect Horizontal15 | Rect Vertical15 | Diamond13 | Box25 |

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_ApplicationLensMode
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Selects the Obsidian Mirror-derived field used to shape where the gathered light is allowed to land in the final composite.
uniforms.ui_items: Off | Organic Lens55 | Golden Spiral Sweep | Staggered Lens55 | Ring9 | Spiral13 | Rect Horizontal15 | Rect Vertical15 | Diamond13 | Box25 |

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_QualityTier
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Caps the active tap count before the user tap budget is applied. Higher tiers keep more of the high-quality tap field alive.
uniforms.ui_items: Disciplined 9 | Broad 21 | High 34 | Ultra 55 |

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_TapBudget
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Requested tap count for the main indirect-light gather field before the lens family size and quality tier clamp are applied. This changes the real GI gather, not just debug. Higher values favor denser and smoother indirect gathers.

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_ApplicationTapBudget
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Requested tap count for the application lens field before the family size and quality tier clamp are applied. This changes the real placement field, not just debug, and affects where GI is allowed to land rather than how it is gathered.

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_ReductionMode
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Sequential consumes the earliest taps first. Staggered redistributes reduced tap counts across the full canonical shape of the active lens so coverage stays even when the budget is below the maximum.
uniforms.ui_items: Sequential | Staggered |

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_FieldScale
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Scales the underlying Obsidian Mirror lens constellation before it is converted into pixel-space gather offsets for the real GI image.

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_FieldRotation
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Rotates the active lens field in the real GI gather and placement paths. This mainly affects directional and anisotropic lens families such as the rectangular and diamond variants.

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_FibonacciAnchor
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Offsets the golden-angle phase used by the Fibonacci-derived lens families in the real gather and placement fields. Changing it re-phases sample ordering without altering the total tap count.

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_GatherRadiusPixels
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Pixel radius of the indirect-light gather. Larger values reach farther and recover broader bounce; smaller values stay tighter and more local.

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_DistanceFalloff
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how quickly far taps lose influence within the active lens field. Lower values keep distant taps strong; higher values bias the gather back toward the center.

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_BrightSampleBias
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Bias toward taps that are brighter than the current pixel. Higher values make Golden Hour recover more luminous neighboring bounce, especially in shadowed regions.

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_ShadowPreference
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Biases the recovered bounce toward darker source regions. Higher values keep the brightening concentrated in shadow and midtone areas instead of lifting the whole scene evenly.

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_BounceSaturation
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Restores or suppresses color saturation in the gathered indirect light. Lower values make the bounce more neutral; higher values let it keep more sampled color character.

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_SourceRetention
uniforms.ui_tooltip: How much of the source color is treated as already-lit before bounce is extracted. Higher values make the GI more conservative by requiring gathered light to rise farther above the source.

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_ApplicationRadiusPixels
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Pixel radius used to evaluate the application lens field in the real GI output. Larger values let the application mask respond to broader neighborhood structure.

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_ApplicationLensStrength
uniforms.ui_tooltip: How strongly the application lens field modulates where the recovered GI is allowed to land in the real composite.

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_MaskMode
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Selects the Crystal Mass-derived field used to gate GI application. Composite Guard combines depth, contrast, distance, and protection behavior into a broader placement guide.
uniforms.ui_items: Off | Fog Evidence | Light Shield | Depth Window | Far Detail Stack | Contrast | Composite Guard |

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_MaskInfluence
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Blends between ungated application and the selected mask field. Lower values let the gather read clearly for tuning; higher values enforce the mask more strongly.

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_MaskStrength
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Scales the selected mask field before it is blended into the final application gate.

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_DepthMode
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Chooses how depth is interpreted before the depth-aware gather and Crystal Mass-derived guards evaluate the scene.
uniforms.ui_items: Linearized | Raw Depth | Raw Inverted |

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_DepthInvert
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Inverts near and far interpretation for reversed depth buffers or alternative depth conventions.
uniforms.ui_items: No | Yes |

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_DepthTraceScale
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Amplifies small depth differences before availability, edge, and reject logic are evaluated. Raise it when valid depth exists but gather acceptance is too weak.

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_DepthAvailabilityThreshold
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Minimum local depth activity required before depth-aware filters fully trust the buffer. Lower values accept weaker depth; higher values demand a clearer signal.

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_DepthRejectStart
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Beginning of the depth mismatch ramp that suppresses off-surface taps. Lower values make the gather more surface-tight.

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_DepthRejectEnd
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Depth mismatch where taps are fully rejected. Raising it tolerates broader depth variation before samples drop out.

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_DepthEdgeThreshold
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Threshold used by the Crystal Mass-derived depth-discontinuity logic. Lower values catch more silhouette changes; higher values reserve the signal for stronger breaks.

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_DepthStart
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Near boundary of the generic depth window used by the depth and composite masks.

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_DepthEnd
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Far boundary of the generic depth window used by the depth and composite masks.

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_FarDetailStart
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Beginning of the far-distance range used by the far-detail and composite masks.

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_FarDetailEnd
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Point where far-distance qualification reaches full strength for the far-detail and composite masks.

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_FogBrightnessFloor
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Minimum brightness before the fog evidence branch begins to react. Raise it to ignore dim haze and focus on brighter atmosphere.

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_FogDesaturation
uniforms.ui_tooltip: How colorless a region should be before fog evidence strengthens. Higher values focus more tightly on neutral mist and haze.

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_FogLowContrast
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Local-contrast threshold used by the fog evidence branch. Lower values make fog detection more selective; higher values allow flatter structure to qualify more easily.

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_LightThreshold
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Brightness threshold used by the light-protection branch. Lower values protect more highlights and emissive accents.

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_LightSoftness
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Transition width of the light-protection branch. Higher values broaden highlight protection instead of clipping it abruptly.

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_ContrastThreshold
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Minimum local contrast required before the contrast branch qualifies. Lower values catch more texture; higher values reserve the field for clearer structure.

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_ContrastGain
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Gain applied to the local contrast probe before thresholding. Raise it when structurally correct contrast fields are too faint to be useful.

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_BreakupMode
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Optional Crooked Tongue-derived breakup field used to subtly shape GI placement. Off keeps the indirect light smooth and purely lens-driven.
uniforms.ui_items: Off | Procedural Bio | Five-Stage | Cross Hatch |

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_BreakupInfluence
uniforms.ui_tooltip: How strongly the breakup field modulates where the final GI lands. Lower values keep the result smoother; higher values introduce more stylized structural modulation.

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_BreakupTapBudget
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Requested tap count for tap-driven breakup branches. This mainly affects the Procedural Bio breakup field, which uses Lens55-derived directional support.

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_BreakupScale
uniforms.ui_tooltip: UV scale of the optional breakup field. Larger values tighten the breakup structure; smaller values keep it broad and slow.

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_BreakupDensity
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Frequency of the optional breakup field. Higher values pack more structure into the same spatial region.

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_BreakupFlow
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Directional phase offset used by the optional breakup field. Changing it re-phases the structure without changing tap count.

uniforms.name: GOLDEN_BreakupTapSpread
uniforms.ui_tooltip: How far Lens55 taps spread when the Procedural Bio breakup branch is active. Larger values produce looser and broader structural drift.

techniques.ui_tooltip: Recovers nearby image color, filters it through sampling and application fields, and adds it back as indirect bounce light.

uniforms.ui_tooltip: Chooses which lens stage to inspect. Tiled Lens Placement Field shows the repeated debug layout of the active tap set, Tiled Tap Index Field colors taps by active sampling order, Center Sample Footprint Overlay shows the true image-facing sampling footprint anchored at screen center, Tiled Tap Coverage Field shows how support accumulates across the repeated debug layout, Analysis Mask shows a selected spatial diagnostic, Analysis Applied Overlay blends that diagnostic onto the live image, Averaged Image shows the live gathered result, and Difference From Source shows what the current lens changes.
uniforms.ui_items: Final (Passthrough) | Tiled Lens Placement Field | Tiled Tap Index Field | Center Sample Footprint Overlay | Tiled Tap Coverage Field | Analysis Mask | Analysis Applied Overlay | Averaged Image | Difference From Source |

uniforms.name: OBSIDIAN_DebugExposure
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Brightens low-signal debug views so sparse tap fields and weak coverage are easier to inspect. Does not change passthrough output.

uniforms.name: OBSIDIAN_DebugGamma
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Display-only gamma for debug outputs. Lower values lift dim detail; higher values compress it. Does not change the final composite when the displayed output is Final.

uniforms.name: OBSIDIAN_DebugContrast
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Display-only contrast for masks, depth fields, detail fields, and other diagnostics. Does not alter the real effect path.

uniforms.name: OBSIDIAN_DebugBlackPoint
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Lower remap point for debug visualization. Raise it to clip low-level noise and isolate stronger diagnostic signal.

uniforms.name: OBSIDIAN_DebugWhitePoint
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Upper remap point for debug visualization. Lower it to expand faint masks, depth variation, and detail probes.

uniforms.name: OBSIDIAN_DebugInvert
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Inverts the shaped debug view only. Useful for inspecting dark depth, inverse masks, and negative-space coverage.
uniforms.ui_items: Off | On |

uniforms.name: OBSIDIAN_DebugPatternScale
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Scales the tiled debug layout only. This changes how large the repeated debug lens appears on screen and does not change the real sample radius used for image gathering.

uniforms.name: OBSIDIAN_DebugPatternTiles
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Repeats the debug lens layout across the screen. This is debug-only and exists to make spacing and rotation easier to judge at a glance.

uniforms.name: OBSIDIAN_DebugMarkerSize
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how large each debug tap marker appears in the tiled pattern and center footprint overlay. This does not change the real sampling footprint size.

uniforms.name: OBSIDIAN_DebugPatternSoftness
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Softens debug marker edges and guide rings. This is a readability control for debug only and does not affect real image sampling.

uniforms.name: OBSIDIAN_AnalysisMode
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Selects which spatial diagnostic Analysis Mask shows. Coverage emphasizes overall support, Voronoi modes show nearest-tap ownership and cell boundaries, Radial and Sequence Order expose ordering behavior, Gap Heat exposes under-supported regions, and Angular Sector shows angular distribution.
uniforms.ui_items: Coverage | Voronoi Cells | Voronoi Edge | Radial Order | Sequence Order | Gap Heat | Angular Sector |

uniforms.name: OBSIDIAN_AnalysisContrast
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Raises contrast in analysis views so tap ownership changes, weak coverage, and gap structure are easier to read. This affects debug only.

uniforms.name: OBSIDIAN_AnalysisBlend
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how boldly categorical analysis colors render in Analysis Mask. Lower values soften diagnostic coloring; higher values show stronger category separation.

uniforms.name: OBSIDIAN_AnalysisApplyStrength
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how strongly the selected analysis diagnostic is blended over the live image in Analysis Applied Overlay. This affects debug only.

uniforms.name: OBSIDIAN_Enable
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Master enable for the mined lens modes. Off keeps the module in passthrough-only mode.
uniforms.ui_items: Off | On |

uniforms.name: OBSIDIAN_LensMode
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Selects the active mined lens family. The rectangular, diamond, and Box25 fields are mined coverage variants that emphasize horizontal sweep, vertical sweep, diamond-biased spread, or dense square neighborhood support rather than purely organic placement.
uniforms.ui_items: Off | Organic Lens55 | Golden Spiral Sweep | Staggered Lens55 | Ring9 | Spiral13 | Rect Horizontal15 | Rect Vertical15 | Diamond13 | Box25 |

uniforms.name: OBSIDIAN_TapBudget
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how many taps are active in the current mined lens for the real image, not just the debug view. Each family clamps this to its own canonical size, so Ring9 tops out at 9, Spiral13 and Diamond13 top out at 13, the rectangular fields top out at 15, Box25 tops out at 25, and the Lens55 families top out at 55.

uniforms.name: OBSIDIAN_SampleRadius
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how far active taps reach in pixel space for the real sampled image output. Larger values spread the lens farther from the center sample.

uniforms.name: OBSIDIAN_ReductionMode
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Sequential uses the earliest taps first. Staggered redistributes reduced tap counts across the full canonical shape of the active lens so lower budgets stay evenly spread instead of bunching near the front of the tap order.
uniforms.ui_items: Sequential | Staggered |

uniforms.name: OBSIDIAN_FieldScale
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Scales the geometric spread of the active lens pattern for real sampling, not just debug preview. Larger values widen the lens constellation before it is converted into pixel-space sampling.

uniforms.name: OBSIDIAN_FieldRotation
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Rotates the active lens field for the actual image gather. This changes the orientation of anisotropic or directional tap distributions.

uniforms.name: OBSIDIAN_FibonacciAnchor
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Offsets the golden-angle phase used by the Fibonacci-derived lens modes in the live sampling field. Changing it rotates and re-phases the distribution without altering tap count.

uniforms.name: OBSIDIAN_AverageMix
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Blends the lens average back toward the source image in Sample Average view. Lower values preserve more of the source; higher values emphasize the aggregate lens sample.

uniforms.name: POTTERY_DebugExposure

uniforms.ui_tooltip: Display-only contrast for masks, depth fields, detail fields, and other diagnostics. Does not alter the real effect path.

uniforms.name: POTTERY_DebugBlackPoint
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Lower remap point for debug visualization. Raise it to clip low-level noise and isolate stronger diagnostic signal.

uniforms.name: POTTERY_DebugWhitePoint
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Upper remap point for debug visualization. Lower it to expand faint masks, depth variation, and detail probes.

uniforms.name: POTTERY_DebugInvert
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Inverts the shaped debug view only. Useful for inspecting dark depth, inverse masks, and negative-space coverage.
uniforms.ui_items: Off | On |

uniforms.name: POTTERY_DebugPatternScale
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Scales only the repeated debug field views. This changes how large the organic field appears in debug and does not change real smoothing.

uniforms.name: POTTERY_DebugPatternTiles
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Repeats the organic field debug layout across the screen. This is only for reading field spacing and rotation.

uniforms.name: POTTERY_DebugMarkerSize
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how large tap markers appear in the tiled field and center footprint debug views. This does not change real sample size.

uniforms.name: POTTERY_DebugPatternSoftness
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Softens the marker edges and guide rings in debug views. This is a readability control only.

uniforms.name: POTTERY_Enable
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Master enable for the three-stage anti-aliasing effect. Off returns the original image unchanged.
uniforms.ui_items: Off | On |

uniforms.name: POTTERY_EnableDirectional
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Enables the first pass, which performs fast directional smoothing along the detected edge direction in an FXAA-like way.
uniforms.ui_items: Off | On |

uniforms.name: POTTERY_EnableNeighborhood
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Enables the second pass, which blends nearby horizontal, vertical, and diagonal neighborhoods in an SMAA-like way.
uniforms.ui_items: Off | On |

uniforms.name: POTTERY_EnableOrganic
uniforms.ui_label: Enable Organic Lens Adjunct Smoothing Pass
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Enables the third pass, which uses the lens server field as an organic adjunct smoothing stage after the FXAA-like and SMAA-like stages.
uniforms.ui_items: Off | On |

uniforms.name: POTTERY_MasterIntensity
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Overall strength multiplier applied after the three anti-aliasing stages are merged and gated.

uniforms.name: POTTERY_EdgeThreshold
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Minimum luma range required before any anti-aliasing is allowed to engage.

uniforms.name: POTTERY_EdgeSoftness
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Soft transition width above the edge threshold. Higher values make anti-aliasing ramp in more gradually.

uniforms.name: POTTERY_OrganicLensMode
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Selects the Obsidian Mirror-derived lens family used by the organic smoothing pass.
uniforms.ui_items: Off | Organic Lens55 | Golden Spiral Sweep | Staggered Lens55 | Ring9 | Spiral13 | Rect Horizontal15 | Rect Vertical15 | Diamond13 | Box25 |

uniforms.name: POTTERY_QualityTier
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Caps the organic tap budget before the active lens family applies its own family-size clamp.
uniforms.ui_items: Disciplined 9 | Broad 21 | High 34 | Ultra 55 |

uniforms.name: POTTERY_OrganicTapBudget
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Requested tap count for the organic lens field before quality-tier and family-size clamping are applied. This changes real smoothing, not just debug.

uniforms.name: POTTERY_ReductionMode
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Sequential uses the earliest taps first. Staggered redistributes reduced tap counts across the full canonical lens shape.
uniforms.ui_items: Sequential | Staggered |

uniforms.name: POTTERY_FieldScale
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Scales the underlying organic lens constellation before it is converted into pixel-space smoothing offsets.

uniforms.name: POTTERY_FieldRotation
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Rotates the organic lens field used by the third anti-aliasing pass.

uniforms.name: POTTERY_FibonacciAnchor
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Offsets the golden-angle phase used by the Fibonacci-derived organic lens families.

uniforms.name: POTTERY_OrganicRadiusPixels
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Pixel radius of the organic lens smoothing pass.

uniforms.name: POTTERY_OrganicEdgeBias
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Biases organic lens weights toward taps aligned with the detected edge direction.

uniforms.name: POTTERY_DirectionalStrength
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Blend strength of the FXAA-like directional smoothing pass.

uniforms.name: POTTERY_DirectionalSpanPixels
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Maximum span sampled along the detected edge direction by the FXAA-like smoothing pass.

uniforms.name: POTTERY_DirectionalSubpixel
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Subpixel weighting for the FXAA-like pass. Higher values extend the directional smoothing footprint.

uniforms.name: POTTERY_NeighborhoodStrength
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Blend strength of the SMAA-like neighborhood blending pass.

uniforms.name: POTTERY_NeighborhoodContrastThreshold
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Contrast gate for the SMAA-like neighborhood blending pass. Higher values make this pass more selective.

uniforms.name: POTTERY_NeighborhoodDiagonalWeight
uniforms.ui_tooltip: How strongly diagonal neighborhood blending contributes relative to horizontal and vertical blending inside the SMAA-like pass.

uniforms.name: POTTERY_OrganicStrength
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Blend strength of the organic lens adjunct smoothing pass.

uniforms.name: POTTERY_OrganicDistanceFalloff
uniforms.ui_tooltip: How quickly farther organic taps lose influence. Higher values bias the organic adjunct pass toward nearer taps.

uniforms.name: POTTERY_OrganicCenterWeight
uniforms.ui_tooltip: How strongly the source pixel is preserved within the organic adjunct pass before neighboring taps are averaged in.

uniforms.name: POTTERY_MaskMode
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Selects the Crystal Mass-derived mask used to gate the anti-aliasing result.
uniforms.ui_items: Off | Fog Evidence | Light Shield | Depth Window | Far Detail Stack | Contrast | Composite Guard |

uniforms.name: POTTERY_MaskInfluence
uniforms.ui_tooltip: How strongly the selected mask field influences the final anti-aliasing gate. At zero the mask is ignored. At one the selected mask is fully respected.

uniforms.name: POTTERY_FogInfluence
uniforms.ui_tooltip: How strongly fog-like regions reduce the final anti-aliasing gate.

uniforms.name: POTTERY_DepthMode
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how the Crystal Mass-derived depth logic interprets the scene depth buffer.
uniforms.ui_items: ReShade Linearized | Raw Depth | Raw Inverted |

uniforms.name: POTTERY_DepthInvert
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Inverts depth interpretation before depth-derived masks are evaluated.
uniforms.ui_items: No | Yes |

uniforms.name: POTTERY_DepthTraceScale
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Scales small depth differences so depth confidence, depth windowing, and far-detail logic read more clearly.

uniforms.name: POTTERY_DepthAvailabilityThreshold
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Minimum useful depth variation required before depth-driven masks are trusted.

uniforms.name: POTTERY_DepthStart
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Near boundary of the selected depth window mask.

uniforms.name: POTTERY_DepthEnd
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Far boundary of the selected depth window mask.

uniforms.name: POTTERY_DepthEdgeThreshold
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Threshold used by depth-edge diagnostics and silhouette-style logic within the Crystal-derived masks.

uniforms.name: POTTERY_FarDetailStart
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Depth where the far-detail mask begins to activate.

uniforms.name: POTTERY_FarDetailEnd
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Depth where the far-detail mask reaches full strength.

uniforms.name: POTTERY_DetailScale
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Scales the detail detector used by the far-detail mask.

uniforms.name: POTTERY_DetailLow
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Low threshold of the detail detector used by the far-detail mask.

uniforms.name: POTTERY_DetailHigh
uniforms.ui_tooltip: High threshold of the detail detector used by the far-detail mask.

uniforms.name: POTTERY_ContrastThreshold
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Threshold used by the contrast-derived mask field.

uniforms.name: POTTERY_ContrastGain
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Gain applied to the local-contrast detector before the contrast mask is formed.

uniforms.name: POTTERY_FogBrightnessFloor
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Brightness floor used by the fog-evidence detector.

uniforms.name: POTTERY_FogDesaturation
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Desaturation floor used by the fog-evidence detector.

uniforms.name: POTTERY_FogLowContrast
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Upper contrast ceiling used by the fog-evidence detector.

uniforms.name: POTTERY_LineThreshold
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Edge threshold used by line-like structure suppression inside the fog-evidence logic.

uniforms.name: POTTERY_LightThreshold
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Brightness threshold used by the light-shield detector.

uniforms.name: POTTERY_LightSoftness
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Transition softness used by the light-shield detector.

techniques.name: PottingClay
techniques.ui_tooltip: Applies three anti-aliasing stages: an FXAA-like directional smoothing pass, an SMAA-like neighborhood blending pass, and an organic lens-field adjunct smoothing pass, then gates the result with a Crystal-derived application mask.
