uniforms.name: SPIRIT_DebugView
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Chooses which Spirit World stage to inspect. Base Result shows the banded foundation, Coarse Contribution and Superfine Contribution show the isolated additions from those passes, and Edge Field, Depth Gate, and Effective Mask Gate expose the main controls behind the stack.
uniforms.ui_items: Final Composite | Base Result | Coarse Contribution | Superfine Contribution | Edge Field | Depth Gate | Effective Mask Gate |

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_DebugExposure
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Brightens low-signal debug outputs so thin edges, weak masks, and subtle superfine detail are easier to read. Does not change the final composite when Debug View is Final Composite.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_DebugGamma
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Display-only gamma for debug outputs. Lower values lift dim detail; higher values compress it. Does not change the final composite when the displayed output is Final.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_DebugContrast
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Display-only contrast for masks, depth fields, detail fields, and other diagnostics. Does not alter the real effect path.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_DebugBlackPoint
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Lower remap point for debug visualization. Raise it to clip low-level noise and isolate stronger diagnostic signal.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_DebugWhitePoint
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Upper remap point for debug visualization. Lower it to expand faint masks, depth variation, and detail probes.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_DebugInvert
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Inverts the shaped debug view only. Useful for inspecting dark depth, inverse masks, and negative-space coverage.
uniforms.ui_items: Off | On |

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_Enable
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Master enable for the Spirit World cell shader stack. Off returns the source image unchanged.
uniforms.ui_items: Off | On |

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_EnableBase
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Enables the base cel-shading pass. This is the primary banding and edge-inking layer.
uniforms.ui_items: Off | On |

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_EnableCoarse
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Enables the broader hatch-weighted coarse pass. This adds large-form stylized shading over the base layer.
uniforms.ui_items: Off | On |

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_EnableSuperfine
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Enables the superfine pass. This adds restrained micro-detail and clarity on top of the broader cell structure.
uniforms.ui_items: Off | On |

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_MasterIntensity
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Overall intensity multiplier for the combined three-pass stack. Lower values keep the effect subtle; higher values push all enabled passes harder.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_BaseStrength
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Blend amount of the banded base pass. Higher values make cel quantization and flat-value grouping more obvious.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_BaseBands
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Number of luminance bands used by the base pass. Lower values give chunkier cel shading; higher values preserve more tonal resolution.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_BaseBandContrast
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Contrast shaping applied before band quantization. Higher values push separation between light and dark bands.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_BaseEdgeStrength
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Darkening strength of the base edge-inking pass. Higher values make contour emphasis more graphic and assertive.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_EdgeRadiusPixels
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Sampling radius used for edge evaluation. Larger values read broader contour structure; smaller values hold onto tight local edges.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_EdgeLumaGain
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Gain applied to luminance edge response before thresholding. Raise it when visible contrast edges are present but not reading strongly enough.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_EdgeDepthGain
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Gain applied to depth-discontinuity response before thresholding. Raise it when silhouette structure exists in depth but the edge pass is too weak.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_EdgeThreshold
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Threshold where edge response begins. Lower values catch more structure; higher values reserve inking for clearer contours.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_EdgeSoftness
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Softness of the edge threshold transition. Lower values make edge inking crisper; higher values blend it more gently.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_CoarseStrength
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Darkening strength of the coarse pass. This controls how strongly the broad hatch and shadow structure shapes the base layer.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_CoarsePatternScale
uniforms.ui_tooltip: UV scale of the coarse hatch field in the real image. Larger values tighten the pattern; smaller values broaden the structural shading shapes.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_CoarseDensity
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Density of the coarse hatch field in the real image. Higher values create denser coarse stylization and heavier directional structure.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_CoarseFlow
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Phase drift for the coarse hatch field in the real image. Changing it alters the organic directional drift without changing tap count.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_CoarseTapSpread
uniforms.ui_tooltip: How far Lens55 support taps spread while building the coarse hatch field in the real image. Larger values produce broader structural reach.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_CoarseFieldTapBudget
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Number of taps used by the coarse hatch field itself. This is independent from the bounded lens support field budget, so the base support and coarse hatch can now be tuned separately.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_CoarseCenterContrast
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Contrast shaping for the centered Fibonacci hatch body used by the coarse pass. Lower values keep the hatch broader and softer; higher values make the centered structure read more sharply.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_CoarseStageBlend
uniforms.ui_tooltip: How strongly the five-stage depth banding influences the coarse field. Higher values make the coarse pass more depth-zoned and staged.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_CoarseShadowStart
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Beginning of the tonal range where coarse shading starts to appear. Lower values allow the coarse layer into brighter areas.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_CoarseShadowEnd
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Full-strength tonal boundary for the coarse layer. Lower values reserve the strongest coarse shading for darker regions only.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_SuperfineStrength
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Strength of the superfine pass. Higher values push micro-detail and clarity more strongly on top of the base and coarse layers.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_SuperfineRadius
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Sampling radius of the superfine neighborhood. Smaller values keep the pass tight and crisp; larger values broaden micro-detail support.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_SuperfineClamp
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Clamp on signed superfine detail contribution. Lower values keep the pass subtle and safer; higher values allow more visible micro-contrast lift.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_SuperfineChromaSafety
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Biases superfine detail toward luminance instead of raw color. Higher values reduce color fizz and keep the micro-detail cleaner.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_LensMode
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Selects the bounded support field used by the base pass. Organic and Staggered are broader organic fields; Diamond13 and Box25 are tighter structured support fields.
uniforms.ui_items: Organic Lens55 | Staggered Lens55 | Diamond13 | Box25 |

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_TapBudget
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Number of support taps used by the bounded lens field in the real image. Each support mode clamps this to its own canonical size.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_ReductionMode
uniforms.ui_tooltip: How reduced tap counts are selected for the active support lens. Sequential takes the earliest taps, while Staggered redistributes lower budgets across the full canonical shape so the support field stays spatially balanced.
uniforms.ui_items: Sequential | Staggered |

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_LensRadiusPixels
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Pixel reach of the bounded lens support field used by the base pass in the real image. Larger values broaden the averaged support neighborhood.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_LensFieldScale
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Geometric scale of the bounded support field in the real image. Higher values spread taps farther within the support constellation.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_LensFieldRotation
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Rotation of the bounded support field in the real image. This mainly affects anisotropic support modes such as Diamond13 and the structured Lens55 reductions.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_FibonacciAnchor
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Phase anchor shared by the bounded lens support field and the centered Fibonacci coarse field. Changing it re-phases their ordering without changing tap count.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_MaskMode
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Chooses the compact Crystal-style gate used to admit or suppress the three-pass stack. Off disables mask gating and lets the stack apply everywhere.
uniforms.ui_items: Off | Fog Evidence | Light Shield | Depth Window | Far Detail | Contrast | Composite Guard |

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_MaskStrength
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Gain applied to the selected mask gate before it modulates the three-pass stack. Raise it when the chosen gate is correct but too weak.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_MaskInfluence
uniforms.ui_tooltip: How strongly the selected mask gate suppresses the coarse and superfine passes. At 0 the advanced passes are ungated; at 1 they fully obey the selected mask.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_DepthMode
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Depth interpretation used by depth-aware edge, gate, and mask logic. Switch this if the depth diagnostics look reversed or flat.
uniforms.ui_items: Linearized | Raw Depth | Raw Inverted |

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_DepthInvert
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Inverts near and far interpretation for alternative depth conventions.
uniforms.ui_items: No | Yes |

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_DepthTraceScale
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Amplifies subtle depth differences before they feed edge detection, depth confidence, and depth-aware masks.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_DepthAvailabilityThreshold
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Minimum local depth activity needed before the shader trusts depth for gating and edge logic.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_DepthEdgeThreshold
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Threshold where depth-discontinuity response begins. Lower values catch more silhouettes; higher values reserve response for stronger breaks.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_DepthStart
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Near boundary of the compact depth window and far-bias logic. Lower values let near structure into the depth gate earlier.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_DepthEnd
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Far boundary of the compact depth window. Together with Depth Start, this controls the core depth acceptance band.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_FarDetailStart
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Near boundary where far-detail logic starts to become active. Also used as a far bias for haze-like fog detection.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_FarDetailEnd
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Full-strength far-detail boundary. Raising it pushes far-detail gating deeper into the scene.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_FogBrightnessFloor
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Brightness floor used by the fog evidence gate. Raising it restricts fog detection to brighter haze and mist.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_FogDesaturation
uniforms.ui_tooltip: How colorless a region must be before the fog gate increases. Higher values focus more strongly on neutral haze.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_FogLowContrast
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Local-contrast threshold used by the fog gate. Lower values make the haze detector more selective.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_LightThreshold
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Brightness threshold where the light-shield gate starts to treat pixels as highlight-critical.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_LightSoftness
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Soft transition width for the light-shield gate. Higher values broaden highlight protection.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_LineThreshold
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Threshold used by line-oriented mask logic and fog edge suppression. Lower values catch more fine structure.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_ContrastThreshold
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Minimum local luminance change required before the contrast gate turns on. Lower values catch more texture and edges.

uniforms.name: SPIRIT_ContrastGain
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Gain applied to local contrast before thresholding. Raise it when the contrast gate is structurally right but too weak.

techniques.name: SpiritWorld
techniques.ui_label: Spirit World :: Three Pass Cell Shading
techniques.ui_tooltip: Applies three layered stylization passes: a base banded shading pass, a coarse hatch-driven shading pass, and a superfine detail pass.

uniforms.ui_tooltip: Overall indirect-light contribution.

uniforms.ui_tooltip: Darkens creases and shallow occluder hits discovered by primitive rays.

uniforms.name: LW_ColorBleed
uniforms.ui_tooltip: How strongly gathered color shifts nearby surfaces.

uniforms.name: LW_SceneBlend
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Final blend between source frame and computed GI result.

uniforms.name: LW_DetailRestore
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Returns local source contrast after GI is applied.

uniforms.name: LW_RayMode
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Gather Only uses one lens tap per direction; Ray March walks along the ray; Hybrid blends both.
uniforms.ui_items: Gather Only | Ray March | Hybrid |

uniforms.ui_tooltip: Maximum active primitive directions before preset and budget caps.

uniforms.name: LW_StepBudget
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Maximum primitive ray steps per direction before preset and budget caps.

uniforms.name: LW_BudgetScale
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Scales active direction and step count without changing the preset.

uniforms.name: LW_RayLengthPixels
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Maximum ray reach in pixels.

uniforms.ui_tooltip: Single-sample gather reach in pixels.

uniforms.name: LW_RayRotation
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Rotates the sampling field.

uniforms.name: LW_OrganicDrift
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Deterministic per-pixel drift used to break rigid ray patterns.

uniforms.name: LW_ApplicationStrength
uniforms.ui_tooltip: How strongly the selected application lens modulates final GI.

uniforms.name: LW_LensRadiusPixels
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Neighborhood radius used for application-lens diagnostics and contrast fields.

uniforms.name: LW_LensSharpness
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Contrast/edge gain used by application lens modes.

uniforms.name: LW_FibonacciAnchor
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Phase anchor for Fibonacci and organic lens synthesis.

uniforms.name: LW_DepthThickness
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Depth tolerance for accepting ray samples as related surfaces.

uniforms.name: LW_DepthBias
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Self-intersection bias for nearby samples.

uniforms.name: LW_DepthFalloff
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Distance falloff along the ray.

uniforms.name: LW_DepthEdgeReject
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Suppresses GI near discontinuities to reduce halos.

uniforms.name: LW_NormalDirectionality
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Weights rays by the depth-derived primitive surface normal.

uniforms.name: LW_SurfaceSpread
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how permissive the surface-normal lobe is.

uniforms.name: LW_BounceSaturation
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Saturation of gathered indirect color.

uniforms.name: LW_ColorTemperature
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Negative cools bounce light, positive warms bounce light.

uniforms.name: LW_EmissivePickup
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Boosts contribution from bright donor pixels.

uniforms.name: LW_ContributionClamp
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Upper bound on indirect contribution before composition.

uniforms.name: LW_ResponseCurve
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Power curve applied to ray-hit coverage and application mask.

uniforms.name: LW_SkyProtect
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Suppresses GI where the depth buffer appears invalid or sky-like.

uniforms.name: LW_FogStart
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Depth position where far/fog protection begins.

uniforms.name: LW_FogProtect
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Suppresses GI in far/fog regions.

uniforms.name: LW_HighlightThreshold
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Luma threshold for highlight/light protection.

uniforms.name: LW_LightProtect
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Restores protected bright pixels toward the original source color.

uniforms.name: LW_StabilityBlend
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Suppresses contribution at unstable depth/edge regions.

uniforms.name: LW_EdgePreserve
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Restores source color around strong color/depth edges.

uniforms.name: HEXING_EYE_DebugView
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Chooses which hatch, mask, or depth diagnostic to display. Use the mask and depth views to verify where the effect is allowed to appear before judging the final shaded image.
uniforms.ui_items: Final (Passthrough) | Hatch Pattern | Luma Bands | Edge Mask | Depth Edge | Far Depth | Depth Reject | Radius Ring | Detail Probe | Hatch Bands | Selected Mask | Application Mask | Final Mask | Linear Depth | Depth Availability |

uniforms.name: HEXING_EYE_DebugExposure
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Brightens dim diagnostic views so weak masks, subtle depth changes, and low-coverage hatch regions are easier to inspect. Does not change final shading.

uniforms.name: HEXING_EYE_DebugGamma
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Display-only gamma for debug outputs. Lower values lift dim detail; higher values compress it. Does not change the final composite when the displayed output is Final.

uniforms.name: HEXING_EYE_DebugContrast
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Display-only contrast for masks, depth fields, detail fields, and other diagnostics. Does not alter the real effect path.

uniforms.name: HEXING_EYE_DebugBlackPoint
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Lower remap point for debug visualization. Raise it to clip low-level noise and isolate stronger diagnostic signal.

uniforms.name: HEXING_EYE_DebugWhitePoint
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Upper remap point for debug visualization. Lower it to expand faint masks, depth variation, and detail probes.

uniforms.name: HEXING_EYE_DebugInvert
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Inverts the shaped debug view only. Useful for inspecting dark depth, inverse masks, and negative-space coverage.
uniforms.ui_items: Off | On |

uniforms.name: HEXING_EYE_HatchMode
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Selects the hatch generator used by the effect. The five-stage families emphasize depth staging, while the log-spiral families create more organic, branch-driven stroke flow.
uniforms.ui_items: Off | Diagonal Hatch A | Diagonal Hatch B | Cross Hatch | Thin Diagonal Hatch | Sparse Hatch | Organic Sketch | Edge Ink | Technical Drawing | Far Detail Hatch | Animated Hatch | Orchestrator Hatch | Five-Stage Small | Five-Stage Med-Small | Five-Stage Very-Small | Five-Stage Blended | Five-Stage Near | Five-Stage Forward | Five-Stage Center | Five-Stage Back | Five-Stage Far | Fibonacci Bio Hatch | Procedural Bio Hatch | Centered Fibonacci Hatch | Log Spiral Hatch | Log Spiral Cross Hatch |

uniforms.name: HEXING_EYE_ApplicationMask
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Selects the placement mask that decides where hatching is allowed. Use this to confine the effect to dark tones, edges, far depth, detail zones, or stepped hatch bands.
uniforms.ui_items: Off | Luma Bands | Edge Mask | Depth Edge | Far Depth | Depth Reject | Radius Ring | Golden21 Detail | Hatch Bands |

uniforms.name: HEXING_EYE_HatchStrength
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how strongly the final hatch darkens the source image. Higher values make the selected hatch family read more aggressively.

uniforms.name: HEXING_EYE_HatchSpacing
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls line spacing for the analytic hatch families. Lower values pack lines tightly for denser shading; higher values open the pattern and make strokes more separated.

uniforms.name: HEXING_EYE_HatchThickness
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how thick each hatch stroke appears within its spacing interval. Higher values make the pattern feel bolder and darker.

uniforms.name: HEXING_EYE_HatchContrast
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Sharpens or softens how decisively hatch lines appear. Higher values create crisper, more binary strokes; lower values keep the pattern gentler.

uniforms.name: HEXING_EYE_AdvancedPatternScale
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Sets the spatial frequency for the synthesized multi-stage and Fibonacci hatch families. Higher values make those patterns finer and more tightly packed across the image.

uniforms.name: HEXING_EYE_HatchAngleA
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Primary hatch angle for analytic line families. Rotating it changes the dominant stroke direction across the image.

uniforms.name: HEXING_EYE_HatchAngleB
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Secondary hatch angle used by cross and layered analytic families. It changes how opposing or supporting stroke sets intersect.

uniforms.name: HEXING_EYE_HatchAngleC
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Tertiary hatch angle used by layered and scribble-like variants. It helps control the character of denser dark-region shading.

uniforms.name: HEXING_EYE_Jitter
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Adds positional wobble to the analytic hatch field. Higher values break up uniform lines and make the pattern feel more hand-drawn.

uniforms.name: HEXING_EYE_AnimationSpeed
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how quickly the Animated Hatch pattern moves over time. Higher values increase visible motion and can introduce shimmer if pushed too far.

uniforms.name: HEXING_EYE_FibonacciTapCount
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Sets how many directional taps contribute to the Fibonacci-driven hatch families. Higher values add complexity and coverage to those synthesized patterns.

uniforms.name: HEXING_EYE_FibonacciReductionMode
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how reduced Fibonacci tap counts are chosen. Staggered spreads taps across the full 89-tap field, while Sequential fills from the earliest taps first.
uniforms.ui_items: Staggered | Sequential |

uniforms.name: HEXING_EYE_FibonacciAnchor
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Shifts the directional phase of Fibonacci-driven hatch families. Changing it can noticeably alter flow, clustering feel, and local line orientation without changing tap count.

uniforms.name: HEXING_EYE_FibonacciFlow
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Offsets the phase used by the bio and Fibonacci-derived hatch families. Use it to move the pattern into a different stable arrangement.

uniforms.name: HEXING_EYE_FibonacciDensity
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how many strokes the synthesized Fibonacci families draw within their pattern space. Higher values create finer, busier hatch fields.

uniforms.name: HEXING_EYE_FibonacciTapSpread
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how far the synthesized Fibonacci taps are spread through pattern space. Higher values increase variation across the hatch field and reduce uniform repetition.

uniforms.name: HEXING_EYE_FiveStageBlendWidth
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how broadly the five-stage depth bands overlap when using the blended or isolated five-stage families. Higher values make transitions between near, forward, center, back, and far feel smoother.

uniforms.name: HEXING_EYE_SpiralGrowth
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how quickly each recursive log-spiral branch expands outward. Higher values spread branches apart faster and create a more open spiral field.

uniforms.name: HEXING_EYE_SpiralTightness
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how tightly the log-spiral branches wind around their centers. Higher values create more angular turn and denser spiral wrapping.

uniforms.name: HEXING_EYE_SpiralBranchCount
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Sets how many branch arms the log-spiral hatch field uses. Higher values produce a richer, more distributed branch network.

uniforms.name: HEXING_EYE_SpiralRecursiveLevels
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how many recursive levels contribute to the log-spiral direction field. More levels add structure but can make the branch field busier.

uniforms.name: HEXING_EYE_SpiralBranchBlend
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Blends between the local Fibonacci lens direction and the recursive branch direction. Lower values keep the hatch more lens-led; higher values make the spiral field dominate.

uniforms.name: HEXING_EYE_LumaThresholdA
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Upper threshold where darkening begins to unlock more hatch coverage. Raising it allows hatching to start earlier in brighter midtones.

uniforms.name: HEXING_EYE_LumaThresholdB
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Middle threshold where additional layers start appearing. It controls when medium-dark regions become more densely hatched.

uniforms.name: HEXING_EYE_LumaThresholdC
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Lowest threshold for the darkest regions. It determines when the deepest tones receive the fullest hatch layering.

uniforms.name: HEXING_EYE_EdgeThreshold
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Sets how much local luminance contrast is required before color-edge masking activates. Lower values catch more outlines and texture transitions.

uniforms.name: HEXING_EYE_DepthEdgeThreshold
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Sets how much depth discontinuity is required before depth-edge masking activates. Lower values pick up finer depth seams and object boundaries.

uniforms.name: HEXING_EYE_DepthInvert
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Flips near and far depth interpretation. Enable it when near objects appear dark in depth views and distant objects appear bright.
uniforms.ui_items: No | Yes |

uniforms.name: HEXING_EYE_DepthLinearizationMode
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Chooses how the shader reads depth before building depth-driven masks. Use Raw or Raw Inverted when ReShade linearized depth looks flat or incorrect in your game.
uniforms.ui_items: ReShade Linearized | Raw Depth | Raw Inverted |

uniforms.name: HEXING_EYE_DepthTraceScale
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Amplifies small depth differences before edge and reject tests. Raise it when depth-based masks look flat or fail to separate foreground from background.

uniforms.name: HEXING_EYE_DepthAvailabilityThreshold
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Sets the minimum local depth activity required before the shader trusts depth. Lower values accept weaker depth signals; higher values reject noisy or nearly flat depth.

uniforms.name: HEXING_EYE_FarDepthStart
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Sets where the far-depth mask begins. Lower values let distant shading start closer to the camera; higher values reserve it for the far background.

uniforms.name: HEXING_EYE_FarDepthFeather
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how gradually the far-depth mask fades in. Higher values create a broader transition from unmasked to fully masked.

uniforms.name: HEXING_EYE_DepthRejectRadius
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how far the shader looks around each pixel when checking for depth disagreement. Higher values make depth rejection respond to broader local structure.

uniforms.name: HEXING_EYE_DepthRejectThreshold
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Sets how much depth mismatch is tolerated before the depth-reject mask turns off. Lower values make the mask stricter around silhouettes and intersections.

uniforms.name: HEXING_EYE_RadiusRing
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Sets the radius of the circular debug mask. Useful for checking where a radial placement mask will appear on screen.

uniforms.name: HEXING_EYE_RadiusRingThickness
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how narrow or broad the ring mask appears. Higher values make the ring easier to read but less precise.

uniforms.name: HEXING_EYE_DetailRadiusPixels
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how far the detail probe samples around each pixel. Higher values make the probe respond to larger surrounding features instead of only fine detail.

uniforms.name: HEXING_EYE_DetailGain
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Scales the strength of the Golden21 detail mask. Higher values make detail-driven placement appear more aggressively.

techniques.name: hexing_eye
techniques.ui_tooltip: Standalone hatch host for inspecting hatch families, tonal masks, edge masks, and depth-driven placement before using the final shaded result.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_DebugView
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Chooses which mask or diagnostic to show. Use Sample Mask and Final Mask to inspect the independent stages, then Combined Mask and Masked Scene to see the result after combination.
uniforms.ui_items: Final (Passthrough) | Sample Mask | Final Mask | Combined Mask | Weighted Mask | Masked Scene | Linear Depth | Depth Availability | Local Contrast | Saturation | Hue | Ring Contrast | Spiral Detail | Box Variance | Directional | Hatch Diagonal | Cross Hatch | Hatch Bands | Line Guard | Pixel Guard | Highlight Protect | Silhouette Protect | Stable Surface |

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_DebugExposure
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Brightens dim debug views so weak masks, subtle depth changes, and low-contrast diagnostics are easier to read. It does not change the actual mask math.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_DebugGamma
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Display-only gamma for debug outputs. Lower values lift dim detail; higher values compress it. Does not change the final composite when the displayed output is Final.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_DebugContrast
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Display-only contrast for masks, depth fields, detail fields, and other diagnostics. Does not alter the real effect path.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_DebugBlackPoint
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Lower remap point for debug visualization. Raise it to clip low-level noise and isolate stronger diagnostic signal.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_DebugWhitePoint
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Upper remap point for debug visualization. Lower it to expand faint masks, depth variation, and detail probes.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_DebugInvert
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Inverts the shaped debug view only. Useful for inspecting dark depth, inverse masks, and negative-space coverage.
uniforms.ui_items: Off | On |

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_SampleMaskMode
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Selects the mask intended for sampling-time decisions. In a consuming shader this is the mask you would use inside loops, ray taps, or weighting logic.
uniforms.ui_items: Off | Always | Never | Luma Dark | Luma Bright | Luma Mid | Saturation High | Saturation Low | Hue Warm | Hue Cool | Hue Green | Contrast | Depth Available | Depth Near | Depth Far | Depth Edge | Depth Reject | Ring Contrast | Spiral Detail | Box Variance | Directional | Hatch Diagonal | Cross Hatch | Hatch Bands | Line Guard | Pixel Guard | Highlight Protect | Foreground Protect | Silhouette Protect | Stable Surface |

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_FinalMaskMode
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Selects the mask intended for final application strength. In a consuming shader this is the mask you would use after the effect has already been computed.
uniforms.ui_items: Off | Always | Never | Luma Dark | Luma Bright | Luma Mid | Saturation High | Saturation Low | Hue Warm | Hue Cool | Hue Green | Contrast | Depth Available | Depth Near | Depth Far | Depth Edge | Depth Reject | Ring Contrast | Spiral Detail | Box Variance | Directional | Hatch Diagonal | Cross Hatch | Hatch Bands | Line Guard | Pixel Guard | Highlight Protect | Foreground Protect | Silhouette Protect | Stable Surface |

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_CombineMode
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how the sample mask and final mask are merged. Multiply is the safest default, Max broadens coverage, Add intensifies it, and Difference highlights where the two masks disagree.
uniforms.ui_items: Multiply | Min | Max | Add | Difference | Sample Only | Final Only |

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_MaskStrength
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Scales the combined mask after sample and final stages are merged. Higher values push the weighted mask closer to full strength and make Masked Scene more obvious.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_SceneMix
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how strongly the weighted mask is visualized over the source image in Masked Scene. Lower values keep more of the original scene visible.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_LumaDarkStart
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Sets where the dark-tone mask starts fading out. Higher values allow more midtones into Luma Dark before the mask weakens.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_LumaDarkFeather
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how gradually the dark-tone mask fades into brighter regions. Higher values make Luma Dark smoother and less binary.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_LumaBrightStart
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Sets where the bright-tone mask begins. Lower values let highlights and upper midtones enter Luma Bright earlier.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_LumaBrightFeather
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how softly the bright-tone mask rises. Higher values make the highlight transition broader and less abrupt.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_LumaMidCenter
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Places the center of the Luma Mid window. Moving it shifts which tonal band is treated as the primary midtone region.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_LumaMidWidth
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how wide the Luma Mid window is before it starts falling off. Higher values include more of the tonal range.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_LumaMidFeather
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Softens the edges of the midtone window. Higher values create a broader transition from strong midtone selection to no selection.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_SaturationHighStart
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Sets where the high-saturation mask begins. Lower values let moderately colorful regions into Saturation High sooner.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_SaturationHighFeather
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how smoothly the high-saturation mask grows. Higher values make colorful transitions less harsh.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_SaturationLowStart
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Sets where the low-saturation mask starts fading out. Higher values keep more muted color inside Saturation Low.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_SaturationLowFeather
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how gradually the low-saturation mask releases into more vivid color. Higher values are more forgiving.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_HueWidth
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how broad each hue-sector mask is around its center. Higher values include a larger color family, while lower values isolate a tighter hue range.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_HueFeather
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Softens the edge of each hue-sector mask. Higher values make warm, cool, and green masks transition more smoothly across neighboring hues.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_ContrastThreshold
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Sets how much local luminance change is required before the Contrast mask turns on. Lower values catch more edges and texture.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_ContrastGain
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Amplifies local contrast before thresholding. Higher values make weak structure read more strongly in the Contrast mask.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_DepthMode
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Chooses how depth is interpreted before depth masks are built. Switch modes when Linear Depth looks flat, inverted, or otherwise wrong for the current game.
uniforms.ui_items: ReShade Linearized | Raw Depth | Raw Inverted |

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_DepthInvert
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Flips near and far interpretation after the selected depth mode is applied. Enable it if near objects appear dark and far objects appear bright when they should not.
uniforms.ui_items: No | Yes |

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_DepthTraceScale
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Amplifies tiny depth differences before edge and reject tests. Raise it when depth-based masks appear too flat to separate scene layers.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_DepthAvailabilityThreshold
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Sets how much local depth activity is required before the shader trusts depth. Higher values are stricter and reject weak or noisy depth feeds.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_DepthNearEnd
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Sets how far the Depth Near mask reaches before it fades out. Higher values extend near coverage farther into the scene.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_DepthNearFeather
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how gradually the near mask fades away. Higher values create a softer near-to-mid transition.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_DepthFarStart
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Sets where the far-depth mask begins. Lower values bring distant masking closer to the camera, while higher values reserve it for deeper background.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_DepthFarFeather
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how softly the far-depth mask rises. Higher values create a broader transition into far-region coverage.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_DepthEdgeThreshold
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Sets how much depth discontinuity is needed before the Depth Edge mask turns on. Lower values catch finer object boundaries.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_DepthRejectRadius
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how far the shader looks for conflicting depth when building Depth Reject. Higher values make rejection respond to broader local structure.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_DepthRejectThreshold
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Sets how much depth mismatch is tolerated before the Depth Reject mask turns off. Lower values make it more protective around silhouettes and intersections.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_SpatialRadiusPixels
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how far spatial masks sample around each pixel. Higher values make ring, spiral, box, and directional masks respond to larger surrounding structure.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_SpatialGain
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Amplifies ring and spiral detail responses. Higher values make subtle neighborhood differences read more strongly in those masks.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_BoxVarianceGain
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Scales the 3x3 variance response used by Box Variance. Higher values make texture and small tonal breaks show up much more clearly.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_DirectionalAngle
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Sets the preferred direction tested by the Directional mask. Rotating it changes which oriented structures are emphasized.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_DirectionalGain
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Amplifies directional difference before thresholding. Higher values make the mask more sensitive to alignment with the chosen angle.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_DirectionalThreshold
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Sets how strong the directional response must be before the Directional mask activates. Lower values catch more subtle orientation.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_DirectionalFeather
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how softly the directional mask rises once it passes threshold. Higher values make orientation selection less abrupt.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_HatchScale
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls line spacing for hatch-derived masks. Lower values make lines denser, while higher values spread the pattern farther apart.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_HatchThickness
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Changes how thick each hatch stroke is inside its spacing interval. Higher values make hatch masks darker and bolder.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_HatchSoftness
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Softens the edge of hatch strokes. Lower values give crisper line masks, while higher values blend line boundaries more gently.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_HatchAngleA
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Primary hatch direction used by Hatch Diagonal and one side of Cross Hatch. Rotating it changes the dominant stroke orientation.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_HatchAngleB
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Secondary hatch direction used by Cross Hatch. Changing it alters how the two stroke families intersect.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_HatchBandA
uniforms.ui_tooltip: First tonal threshold for Hatch Bands. Raising it allows the first hatch layer to appear in brighter tones.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_HatchBandB
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Second tonal threshold for Hatch Bands. It controls when a denser stepped hatch zone becomes active.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_HatchBandC
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Third tonal threshold for Hatch Bands. Lower values reserve the strongest stepped hatch response for the darkest tones only.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_LineGuardThreshold
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Sets how strong a local luminance gradient must be before thin-line protection activates. Lower values make the line guard catch more fine structures.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_LineGuardStrength
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Scales the line-protection mask after detection. Higher values make protected line structures survive more strongly in downstream use.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_PixelGuardThreshold
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Brightness threshold where hot-pixel protection starts. Lower values make the mask pick up more bright micro-details.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_PixelGuardSaturation
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Minimum saturation required for color-driven hot-pixel protection. Lower values make the mask catch more vivid pixels.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_PixelGuardStrength
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Scales the hot-pixel protection mask. Higher values preserve bright or saturated micro-pixels more aggressively.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_HighlightProtectStart
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Sets where broad highlight protection begins. Lower values bring more upper-midtones into the protected region.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_HighlightProtectFeather
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how softly the highlight-protection mask rolls in. Higher values make bright-region protection more gradual.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_HighlightProtectSaturation
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Minimum saturation required for color-biased highlight protection. Lower values let colorful highlights enter the mask sooner.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_HighlightProtectColorBias
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Blends between pure brightness-driven highlight protection and added saturation-driven protection. Higher values favor vivid emissive colors.

uniforms.name: KALEIDOSCOPE_SilhouetteContrastBias
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how much color-contrast edges contribute relative to depth edges in the silhouette-protection mask. Higher values make silhouettes respond more strongly to image edges.

techniques.name: kaleidoscope
techniques.ui_tooltip: Displays sample-mask fields, final-mask fields, mask combination logic, and the supporting color, depth, spatial, hatch, and protection diagnostics used to construct image masks.

uniforms.name: LOOKING_GLASS_DebugView
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Chooses which lens debug output to show. Pattern and Tap Index visualize placement, Sample views show image response, Analysis Mask shows raw spatial diagnostics, and Analysis Applied Overlay shows the selected analysis mask applied over the live image.
uniforms.ui_items: Final (Passthrough) | Lens Pattern | Tap Index | Sample Footprint Overlay | Sample Average | Sample Delta | Analysis Mask | Analysis Applied Overlay |

uniforms.name: LOOKING_GLASS_DebugExposure
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Brightens dim debug views so sparse taps, weak overlays, and low-contrast analysis fields are easier to inspect. Does not change sampling or final image output.

uniforms.name: LOOKING_GLASS_DebugGamma
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Display-only gamma for debug outputs. Lower values lift dim detail; higher values compress it. Does not change the final composite when the displayed output is Final.

uniforms.name: LOOKING_GLASS_DebugContrast
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Display-only contrast for masks, depth fields, detail fields, and other diagnostics. Does not alter the real effect path.

uniforms.name: LOOKING_GLASS_DebugBlackPoint
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Lower remap point for debug visualization. Raise it to clip low-level noise and isolate stronger diagnostic signal.

uniforms.name: LOOKING_GLASS_DebugWhitePoint
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Upper remap point for debug visualization. Lower it to expand faint masks, depth variation, and detail probes.

uniforms.name: LOOKING_GLASS_DebugInvert
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Inverts the shaped debug view only. Useful for inspecting dark depth, inverse masks, and negative-space coverage.
uniforms.ui_items: Off | On |

uniforms.name: LOOKING_GLASS_LensMode
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Selects the tap layout used by all previews and sample-based debug modes. Pair, box, diamond, and ring lenses are useful for oriented analysis, while bounded and Fibonacci families give broader organic coverage.
uniforms.ui_items: Off | Point1 | Horizontal Pair2 | Vertical Pair2 | Diagonal Pair2 A | Diagonal Pair2 B | Cross5 | X5 | CrossX9 | Box4 | Box9 | Box25 | Rect Horizontal15 | Rect Vertical15 | Diamond9 | Diamond13 | Ring4 | Ring8 | Ring9 | Ring12 | Radial13 | Spiral13 | Golden21 | Bounded55 | Fibonacci55 | Fibonacci89 |

uniforms.name: LOOKING_GLASS_AnalysisMaskMode
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Selects the analysis coloring used by Analysis Mask. These modes help inspect coverage gaps, ordering, Voronoi ownership, and how reduced tap counts distribute across the lens.
uniforms.ui_items: Off | Coverage | Voronoi Cells | Voronoi Edge | Radial Order | Sequence Order | Gap Heat | Angular Sector |

uniforms.name: LOOKING_GLASS_SampleRadiusPixels
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how far each tap samples from the center in pixel space. Higher values widen the true sampling footprint and make Sample Average and Sample Delta respond more strongly.

uniforms.name: LOOKING_GLASS_RotationDegrees
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Rotates the active tap layout around the center without changing tap count or relative spacing. Use it to inspect directional bias or align a lens with scene structure.

uniforms.name: LOOKING_GLASS_PreviewRadius
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Scales the on-screen debug layout for Lens Pattern, Tap Index, Analysis Mask, and the tiled portion of Sample Footprint Overlay. It does not change the real sample radius used for image fetches.

uniforms.name: LOOKING_GLASS_PreviewTiles
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Repeats the debug pattern across the screen. Higher values show more copies of the lens layout, which is useful when comparing spacing and rotation at a glance.

uniforms.name: LOOKING_GLASS_MarkerSize
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Changes how large each tap appears in debug previews and overlays. Larger values make individual taps easier to read, especially in dense Fibonacci layouts.

uniforms.name: LOOKING_GLASS_PatternSoftness
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Softens the edges of debug markers and guide rings. Lower values give crisp dots and rings, while higher values create broader, more blended previews.

uniforms.name: LOOKING_GLASS_DeltaBoost
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Amplifies the difference image in Sample Delta. Raise it when the lens effect is subtle and you want to see which areas the current layout changes the most.

uniforms.name: LOOKING_GLASS_AverageMix
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Blends between the untouched image and the lens-averaged image in Sample Average. Lower values keep more of the source; higher values reveal the full averaging effect.

uniforms.name: LOOKING_GLASS_FibActiveTapCount
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Sets how many taps are active for Fibonacci lens families. Lower values reduce cost and simplify the layout while trying to keep coverage spread across the full lens.

uniforms.name: LOOKING_GLASS_FibReductionMode
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how reduced Fibonacci tap counts are chosen. Staggered keeps taps spread over the full pattern, while Sequential fills from the earliest canonical taps first.
uniforms.ui_items: Staggered | Sequential |

uniforms.name: LOOKING_GLASS_AnalysisContrast
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Increases contrast in Analysis Mask views so boundaries, ownership changes, and gap differences are easier to see.

uniforms.name: LOOKING_GLASS_AnalysisBlend
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how strongly some analysis coloring is blended into the debug output. Higher values make categorical analysis views read more boldly.

uniforms.name: LOOKING_GLASS_AnalysisApplyStrength
uniforms.ui_tooltip: Controls how strongly the Analysis Applied Overlay debug view applies the selected analysis mask over the live image. This affects debug visualization only.
